name: Bikini Atoll Nuclear Test Site
description: Bikini Atoll is a ring of coral islands around a vast lagoon in the Marshall Islands, about 850 km northwest of Majuro. Between 1946 and 1958 the United States carried out 67 nuclear tests here, after relocating the islanders. Divers can still visit warships sunk in 1946, and the huge crater left by the 1954 Bravo blast remains. The atoll is still too contaminated for people to resettle.
